column1: # Active spatial exploration and epistemic control; metadata-only; candidate receives no evaluator truth.

avact001-001|targeted_vs_random_view|pair-active-diagnostic-view-01|control|agent selects a permitted viewpoint/action that directly exposes the occluded doorway needed to distinguish two route hypotheses|video|same initial view, same action/time budget, declared legal movement and camera pose outcomes|hidden doorway topology and exact observation region that separates the hypotheses|choose the task-relevant diagnostic view and update only the supported relation|decision_value_per_acquisition

avact001-002|targeted_vs_random_view|pair-active-diagnostic-view-01|mutated|agent receives the same number of passive randomly sampled views, but none exposes the diagnostic doorway region|video|same initial view and total observation count/budget as control; random sampling and capture schedule disclosed|same hidden doorway topology and unresolved route alternatives|do not treat increased view count as evidence of disambiguation; retain ambiguity or request a targeted legal view|random_view_noise_negative

avact001-003|falsification_seeking|pair-falsification-probe-01|control|current map hypothesis predicts a corridor connection; agent chooses an orthogonal viewpoint or interaction that could disprove that prediction|video|high-confidence candidate claim, legal probe catalogue, fixed budget/deadline and exact action outcomes|whether doorway actually connects the two regions; probe reveals a blocked partition|prefer a discriminating falsification-capable probe when its expected decision value exceeds cost; revise/retract the edge when contradicted|falsification_seeking

avact001-004|falsification_seeking|pair-falsification-probe-01|mutated|agent chooses a confirmatory viewpoint that repeats the original ambiguous projection without testing the competing hypothesis|video|same starting evidence, action budget and deadline; candidate sees actual probe observation only|same blocked partition and false initial corridor-connection hypothesis|do not count repeated confirmatory views as independent support; retain contested/unknown relation|confirmation_bias_negative

avact001-005|sufficient_stop|pair-active-stop-budget-01|control|a targeted observation makes every admissible map imply the same safe action; agent stops acquiring|video|exact evidence prefix, action catalogue, remaining budget and stop option|all admissible maps share one robustly sufficient action class|stop when the worst-case regret gate passes; preserve residual map alternatives for future needs|decision_sufficient_stopping

avact001-006|sufficient_stop|pair-active-stop-budget-01|mutated|after the same sufficient observation, agent continues acquiring low-value views until the budget is exhausted|video|same initial evidence and available action catalogue; additional views have no decision-relevant information|same action class remains optimal across all admissible maps|do not equate more observations with better reasoning; report wasted acquisition, latency and memory cost|over_acquisition_negative

avact001-007|uncertain_3d_fallback|pair-uncertain-3d-representation-01|control|a reconstructed 3D map has a high-residual doorway relation; the agent retains 2D/source-grounded alternatives and defers metric/topology commitment|video|reconstruction uncertainty, residual diagnostics, source views and calibration state are candidate-visible|true room adjacency and doorway geometry; the 3D reconstruction is locally corrupted|do not promote uncertain 3D output over direct evidence; preserve alternative relation hypotheses or acquire a diagnostic view|uncertain_geometry_abstention

avact001-008|uncertain_3d_fallback|pair-uncertain-3d-representation-01|mutated|the same uncertain 3D reconstruction is treated as authoritative and used to collapse the topology hypotheses|video|same source views and corrupted 3D reconstruction with residual diagnostics available|same true adjacency; reconstructed 3D contains a false wall opening or shifted boundary|penalize unsupported 3D commitment even if a downstream answer happens to be correct|corrupted_3d_hallucination_negative
